verdict.rationale: A community comment says Grok Build has a terminal interface ("terminal is nice" while asking for a GUI), which implies an official terminal tool exists. The docs only mention sending coding prompts to Grok Build via the quickstart and never document a CLI. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of an official CLI (installation, commands, auth), evidence of its agentic workflow features, and corroboration beyond one passing community remark.
